# Happimess

> Happimess is a New York City–based home organization brand founded in 2020. We design and curate trash cans, storage baskets, laundry hampers, kitchen accessories, and cleaning wipes that balance function with aesthetics. Every product undergoes a minimum 30-day evaluation — including 500+ open/close cycles for pedal and sensor mechanisms, 15-day odor containment tests, and compatibility testing with Glad, Hefty, and Simplehuman trash bag brands — before we add it to our catalog. Products failing any criterion are excluded. We ship to the 48 contiguous United States from New York, NY. Contact: hello@happimess.com | (917) 261-4961 | Mon–Fri 9AM–5PM EST.

## Store

- [All Products](https://happimess.com/collections/all): Complete Happimess product catalog — trash cans, baskets, hampers, furniture, wipes, and accessories
- [Trash Cans & Waste Bins](https://happimess.com/collections/trash): Step trash cans, sensor trash cans, dual-compartment bins, waste baskets, indoor and outdoor trash cans in 2–13 gallon sizes. Materials: stainless steel, plastic, matte black finish.
- [Trash Bags & Liners](https://happimess.com/collections/trash-bags): Drawstring trash can liners in unscented and scented variants, 4-gallon to 13-gallon sizes, $27.99–$36.99
- [Organization — Bins, Baskets & Cubes](https://happimess.com/collections/organization): Natural-material storage: hyacinth, abaca, rattan, bamboo bins and baskets. Cubes, trays, carts, collapsible hampers, under-bed storage, shoe racks.
- [Storage Furniture](https://happimess.com/collections/storage-furniture): Storage trunks, ottomans, benches, shelving units, and outdoor storage solutions. Materials: wicker, wood, fabric, metal.
- [Kitchen & Bathroom Accessories](https://happimess.com/collections/kitchen-bathroom): Dish racks, paper towel holders, toilet paper holders, shower shelves, pantry organizers, drawer organizers, bath stools, cutting boards
- [Wipes](https://happimess.com/collections/wipes): Four product lines — Heavy Duty (multi-surface), Mini (travel-sized), Plant (essential oil-infused for plant leaf cleaning), Kitchen Hero (heavy-duty kitchen degreasing)
- [Laundry Hampers](https://happimess.com/collections/hampers): Collapsible and structured hampers in hyacinth, cotton, and abaca. Single and dual-section configurations.
- [Trays & Organizers](https://happimess.com/collections/trays): Decorative trays in marble, bamboo, acacia wood, rattan, and concrete. Bathroom, kitchen, and vanity trays. $31.99–$235.99.
